description: Bridges in the City of Port Adelaide Enfield is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Port Adelaide Enfield Council. Bridges in the City of Port Adelaide Enfield that the Council is responsible for the maintenance of. The majority of these bridges are structures for pedestrians only. Bridges are represented by line features. Coverage: Port Adelaide Enfield Council. The portal files it under the publisher Port Adelaide Enfield Council. Its tags are assets, bridge, bridges, government assets, infrastructure. It offers 1 resource(s) in MIXED FORMATS. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
